reason: I already charge my AngelSense every night and it works, so this has to beat something I trust. I research for weeks in my support groups, and I have never heard of TODO, and the pitch shows no reviews or any parent who uses it.
objection: Battery life: live video will drain a tracker faster than my current one, and a camera on someone with dementia who pulls things off will just end up in a drawer.
would_change_my_mind: Independent reviews from caregivers who have used it for months, showing the battery lasts a full day with live video on and the device survives a dementia patient pulling at it.
